column2: A $30 pack returns $284.23 on average if every card is sold raw - about 9.5x the pack cost. After grading the best card and buying the Neon Sign, the shop nets about $343/day against $15/day rent. Cash is never the binding constraint; the skill is picking which cards are worth the $25 grading fee, and the pacing is the day cycle, not affordability.

If the Lab wants a tighter early game, the levers are pack price, base-value ranges, or the guaranteed-card odds - not the grading fee, which is already the decision point. No numbers were changed in this update; this note is here so the next balance pass starts from measured numbers, not a guess.
